subject.title: Oakland Unified School District Board, District 4

photo.credit: Printed in Alameda County's Voter Information Guide

text: I, MIKE HUTCHINSON, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: Mike Hutchinson
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 4
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Public education advocate
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): Oakland School Board District 5, Oakland School Board District 4

5. Statement of General Qualifications: I was born and raised in Oakland, graduated from Skyline High School, and am now a new father whose own daughter will depend on the schools I’m fighting to improve. For 30+ years I’ve worked in Oakland’s public schools as an educator, youth advocate, and organizer, including serving on the School Board for the past six years. I know what’s holding OUSD back: failed leadership, financial mismanagement, lack of a strategic plan, and decision-making that shuts families out. We know what will move us forward: an excellent superintendent, a fiscal solvency plan, real accountability, and authentic community engagement where community members are treated as partners rather than an afterthought. This November, we have the chance to elect a School Board that will get Oakland’s public schools back on track ensuring the high-quality, community schools that every student deserves. Proven homegrown leadership. Vote Mike Hutchinson for quality, public, neighborhood schools.

6. The signatures of not more than twenty nor less than ten residents of the City of Oakland sponsoring my candidacy are as follows: Harriet Hutchinson
Daniel Hutchinson

Jorge Lerma

text: I, KATHRYN CAMP, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: Kathryn Mary Camp
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 4
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Public Policy Professional and Regulatory Affairs Professional
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: Every Oakland student deserves an excellent public education. Our children require leadership grounded in sound judgment, accountability, and fiscal responsibility. As an OUSD parent, public policy professional, and school-community leader, I bring over 20 years of experience solving complex problems, building consensus, and managing multimillion-dollar budgets. My family moved and sacrificed so my sisters and I could attend strong public schools in the Bay Area. No family should have to make that choice. While working full-time, I returned to college, starting at Laney and earning advanced degrees from UC Berkeley. As your School Board Director, I will ask before every decision: Will this help students succeed? My priorities are stronger literacy and math, expanded career pathways, support for educators, family engagement, transparent oversight, and responsible budgeting. I will make independent, data-based decisions - not political ones - focused on students and restoring trust. I respectfully ask for your vote. www.kathryncamp.com

text: I, SYLVIA PFEIFFER WILLIAMS, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: Sylvia Pfeiffer Williams
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 4
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Teacher
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: I was an adult educator in OUSD for over 20 years. I also worked in Special Education and 6 years as union rep. Concerned with school district finances, I earned a Certificate in Education Finance from Georgetown University. I’m certain we can fund what’s important to OUSD families, but we must align our budgeting with what we believe in. I’m excited to work together with constituents and other board members to define our goals, fund our priorities, and direct every penny to the classroom. I believe in clear communication with District Four residents, constructive and consistent participation in board business, and working every day towards educational equity, so all students can bloom and grow in OUSD. Let’s work together for safe schools, community schools, adult education, and education justice. Believe in Oakland kids! Believe in Oakland schools! Believe in Oakland!
